ideas.hypothesis: A short pullback inside an established 1-month uptrend tends to partly reverse because one-week losers mean-revert (short-term reversal) while the intermediate trend keeps going, so buying the dip combines two documented effects.
ideas.rule: Entry: d20 >= +5% AND d5 <= -3% AND d1 > -3% (no fresh crash) AND below_3m_high >= -10% AND entry cost <= 1.5%. If more than 2 names qualify, buy the 2 with the most negative d5. Size: max whole shares under the 25% cap. Horizon 10 trading days; exit at horizon or the -8% stop. No re-entry in a name already held.
ideas.source: Jegadeesh (1990) and Lehmann (1990) on weekly reversal; Jegadeesh & Titman (1993) on intermediate momentum; combination is own hypothesis
